groups.name: Self HP State
groups.summary: Gates on the acting actor's own health fraction or Death's Door status.

groups.name: Target HP State
groups.summary: Gates on the current target's health fraction.

groups.name: Resolve & Stress State
groups.summary: Gates on the actor's stress value or Affliction/Virtue resolve state.

groups.name: Position, Rank & Movement
groups.summary: Gates on which rank the actor or target occupies, or on party movement.

groups.name: Combat Timing & Turn Order
groups.summary: Gates on round number and where the actor falls in the turn order.

groups.name: Attack & Skill Shape
groups.summary: Gates on melee/ranged classification or a specific skill being used.

groups.name: Status, Stealth & Guard
groups.summary: Gates on status tokens, buffs, quirks, stealth, guard, riposte, vampire, burning or corpse states on self or target.

groups.name: Monster Type, Size & Count
groups.summary: Gates on the monster type or size of the actor, target, or attacker, or on how many of a type are present.

groups.name: Mode & Class
groups.summary: Gates on the actor's battle mode/stance or base hero class.

groups.name: Light & Torch
groups.summary: Gates on the current torch/light level or the torch meta setting.

groups.name: Location & Context
groups.summary: Gates on where the party is: camp, dungeon, or a town activity.

groups.name: Inventory, Quirks & Quest
groups.summary: Gates on held items/trinkets, negative-quirk count, or remaining quest-item uses.

rules.name: Always
rules.summary: Unconditional baseline — the buff is always live. This is the default rule when none is specified.

rules.name: Self HP Below
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's own HP fraction is below the given threshold. Classic 'last stand / desperation' gate.

rules.name: Self HP Above
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's own HP fraction is above the given threshold. 'Healthy / full-strength' gate.

rules.name: At Death's Door
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is at Death's Door (HP reduced to zero, on the brink). Great for do-or-die effects.

rules.name: On Entering Death's Door
rules.summary: Fires at the moment the actor enters Death's Door (the transition), rather than for the whole duration spent there.

rules.name: Target HP Below
rules.summary: Applies while the current target's HP fraction is below the given threshold. Classic 'execute / finisher' gate.

rules.name: Target HP Above
rules.summary: Applies while the current target's HP fraction is above the given threshold. 'Opener vs a full-health enemy' gate.

rules.name: Stress Below
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's stress value is below the given number. 'Composed / calm' gate.

rules.name: Stress Above
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's stress value is above the given number. 'Rattled / near meltdown' gate.

rules.name: Afflicted
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is in an Affliction resolve state (broke under stress). 'Cornered rat / berserk' gate.

rules.name: Virtued
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is in a Virtue resolve state (rallied against stress). 'Heroic surge' gate.

rules.name: Self In Rank
rules.summary: Applies while the acting actor occupies the given rank (1 = frontmost, 4 = backmost). The most-used positional gate.

rules.name: Target In Rank
rules.summary: Applies while the target occupies the given rank (1 = frontmost, 4 = backmost).

rules.name: Walking Backwards
rules.summary: Applies while the party is moving backwards (retreating through a corridor).

rules.name: In Room
rules.summary: Applies while the party is in a room (as opposed to a corridor).

rules.name: In Corridor
rules.summary: Applies while the party is in a corridor (as opposed to a room).

rules.name: First Round Only
rules.summary: Applies only during the first combat round. Inverted (is_false_rule), it means every round AFTER the first.

rules.name: Activated First
rules.summary: Applies when the actor acted first this round (highest effective speed / went before allies and enemies).

rules.name: Activated Last
rules.summary: Applies when the actor acted last this round (cleanup slot). Good for finisher/cleanup effects.

rules.name: Melee Only
rules.summary: Applies only to melee effects/skills. Gates a buff to a melee-focused build.

rules.name: Ranged Only
rules.summary: Applies only to ranged effects/skills. Gates a buff to a ranged-focused build.

rules.name: During Specific Skill
rules.summary: Applies only during a specific named skill. Lets a buff power up (or gate to) one particular ability.

rules.name: Actor Status Token
rules.summary: Applies while the actor has a given status/token (e.g. a mark or condition token). String-keyed.

rules.name: Is Actor Status
rules.summary: Actor status-token check (status-based variant of actorStatus). Applies while the actor carries the named status. String-keyed.

rules.name: Has Buff
rules.summary: Applies while the actor currently has a named buff active. Lets one buff key off another (combo/stacking gates).

rules.name: Has Quirk
rules.summary: Applies while the actor has a specific quirk. Rewards or keys off a particular character trait.

rules.name: Self Is Stealthed
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is stealthed. 'From the shadows' gate.

rules.name: Target Is Stealthed
rules.summary: Applies while the target is stealthed. Useful for stealth-piercing or anti-stealth effects.

rules.name: Self Is Guarded
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is being guarded by an ally.

rules.name: Target Is Guarded
rules.summary: Applies while the target is being guarded by one of its allies.

rules.name: Self Is Guarding
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is guarding someone else. 'Protector / tank' gate.

rules.name: Target Is Guarding
rules.summary: Applies while the target is guarding one of its allies.

rules.name: In Riposte
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is in a riposte state (ready to counter). 'Counterattacker' gate.

rules.name: Self Is Vampire
rules.summary: Applies while the actor has the vampire (Crimson Curse) condition.

rules.name: Target Is Vampire
rules.summary: Applies while the target has the vampire (Crimson Curse) condition.

rules.name: Target Is Burning
rules.summary: Applies while the target is on fire (has a burn DoT). Synergizes with burn-focused builds.

rules.name: Any Is Burning
rules.summary: Applies while any relevant actor is burning (has a burn DoT). Broader fire-synergy gate.

rules.name: Target Is Corpse
rules.summary: Applies while the target is a corpse. Useful for corpse-clearing or necromancy-flavored effects.

rules.name: Actor Monster Type
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's monster type matches the given token (e.g. eldritch, unholy, beast). The core 'slayer' gate. String-keyed.

rules.name: Monster Size
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's monster size matches the given value (e.g. large enemies occupy multiple ranks).

rules.name: Monster Type Count Minimum
rules.summary: Applies when at least N of a given monster type are present on the field. 'Horde bonus' gate. Takes both a count and a type token.
rules.rule_data: Minimum count (number) plus a monster type token (string)

rules.name: Attacking Monster Type
rules.summary: Applies while the attacker (who is hitting the actor) is of the given monster type. 'Revenge / defensive vs type' gate. String-keyed.

rules.name: In Battle Mode
rules.summary: Applies while the actor is in a given battle mode/stance (e.g. a class's stance toggle). String-keyed.

rules.name: Actor Base Class
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's base hero class matches the given class id. Class-gated buffs. String-keyed.

rules.name: Light Below
rules.summary: Applies while the torch/light level is below the threshold. 'Dark / shadow build' gate.

rules.name: Light Above
rules.summary: Applies while the torch/light level is above the threshold. 'Bright / radiant build' gate.

rules.name: Torch Setting
rules.summary: Applies while the torch/light meta setting matches the given id (a discrete torch preset rather than a level threshold).

rules.name: In Camp
rules.summary: Applies while the party is currently in camp. The standard gate for camping-skill buffs.

rules.name: In Dungeon
rules.summary: Applies while the party is inside a dungeon/raid (on an expedition). Distinguishes dungeon effects from town.

rules.name: In Town Activity
rules.summary: Applies while in a town-activity context (e.g. tavern/abbey stress-relief building). Gates town side-effect buffs.

rules.name: Has Item Id
rules.summary: Applies while the party inventory holds a specific item id. Item-gated buffs.

rules.name: Has Item Type
rules.summary: Applies while the party inventory holds an item of the given type (a category rather than a specific id). String-keyed.

rules.name: No Trinkets
rules.summary: Applies while the actor has no trinkets equipped. Enables 'no-trinket challenge' rewards.

rules.name: Negative Quirk Count Above
rules.summary: Applies while the actor's count of negative quirks is above the threshold. Rewards (or penalizes) a flawed character.

rules.name: Quest Uses Remaining Above
rules.summary: Applies while a quest item's remaining uses are above the threshold. Keys off a consumable/charged quest object.
